name: IPFS Cluster Self-Hosted Pin Orchestration
free_limit: MIT/Apache-2.0 dual-licensed pinset replication and orchestration across self-operated IPFS/Kubo nodes; no software license fee or hosted storage quota.
watch_out: Requires separate Kubo/IPFS peers, disk, compute, networking and ongoing pin availability. This is pin orchestration rather than a managed free pinning service; third-party pinning/gateway services may charge. Verify upstream maintenance and security before production use.
